context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 商談/延び/挑ん/ショートカット/変われ/つなげる/折り紙/乗り継ぎ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、商談、若いうちに、見学経験、しろ。
lines.en: Ren — watch negotiations while you're still young. It'll shape how you think.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Measured pace, deliberate pauses between thoughts. Not commanding — advising. The voice of someone who's watched many young people grow. Slight lean forward, genuine investment in being heard.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。期限が延びた案件、勉強になります。
lines.en: Yes. These extended-timeline cases are teaching me a lot.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly formal. Quick agreement, then a shift to earnestness on the second thought. Not rehearsed — genuine appreciation surfacing as he speaks. Sitting straighter, engaged.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 難題に挑んだ経験、自信に繋げろ。
lines.en: Take on the hard problems. That's what builds real confidence.
lines.style: Even, unadorned delivery. Weight on 「挑んだ」equivalent — not pushing, stating a fact he knows. Calm certainty. The voice of someone who's tested this truth many times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ITのショートカット、若手から学ぶことも多いです。
lines.en: There's a lot I can learn from the younger developers too — their shortcuts, their approach.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly self-correcting. Acknowledges his own blindness with a small half-smile in the voice. Humble without performing humility. Honest hesitation before admitting it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 環境が変われば、自分も変わる。
lines.en: When your environment changes, you change with it.
lines.style: Almost aphoristic. Gentle but not soft — the voice of lived experience. Slight pause before and after, letting it settle. Not bombastic. Simple and true.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 業界人をつなげる橋渡し、目指したいです。
lines.en: I want to be the kind of person who connects people across the industry — bridges gaps.
lines.style: Reaches for something larger than himself. Voice opens up slightly — less guarded. Earnest aspiration but grounded, not dreamy. Eye contact level rises with the idea.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様への折り紙、企業の温かさ、伝わるな。
lines.en: That thoughtfulness — the origami for clients — it shows the company's warmth. People feel it.
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Warm without sentimentality. Recognition of something true and worth naming. Steady, almost fond. Affirming without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外出張時、乗り継ぎ、注意します。
lines.en: And when you travel internationally, pay attention to your connections — don't miss your transfers.
lines.style: Shifts to practical, almost grandfatherly. Light touch of humor — the advice wrapping back to the concrete. Not patronizing. Warm close, matter-of-fact. A final steadying hand on the shoulder.
